comment: Display taxonomy. Assignments live in data/topic_assignments_v2.json and are applied at build time; the ledger keeps its original topic_ids.

topics.name: Selfish Mining & Withholding
topics.definition: Selfish mining, stubborn mining, block withholding, strategic block release and fork-based attacks by miners.

topics.name: Mining Pools & Reward Sharing
topics.definition: Pool formation, pool games, payout and reward-sharing schemes, pool hopping.

topics.name: Mining Economics
topics.definition: Miner revenue and costs, hash-rate supply and entry, mining equilibrium, difficulty adjustment and block-reward schedules, halvings.

topics.name: PoS Consensus & Validators
topics.definition: Proof-of-stake protocol incentives, validator rewards, slashing, committee or leader selection, randomness manipulation.

topics.name: Staking, Restaking & Delegation
topics.definition: Staking markets, liquid staking, restaking, delegation and staking pools.

topics.name: Consensus with Rational Players
topics.definition: BFT, SMR and agreement protocols analysed with rational or strategic participants, not specific to PoW mining or PoS rewards.

topics.name: Protocol Foundations
topics.definition: Foundational blockchain protocol design or analysis: Bitcoin, Nakamoto consensus, security and latency trade-offs, new chain designs whose incentives are central.

topics.name: Transaction Fee Mechanism Design
topics.definition: Mechanism design and theory of transaction fees: EIP-1559, incentive compatibility, blockspace auctions, multidimensional fees.

topics.name: Fee Markets in Practice
topics.definition: Empirical gas and fee markets, congestion, fee estimation behaviour, EIP-1559 and EIP-4844 measurement.

topics.name: MEV Extraction & Measurement
topics.definition: Maximal extractable value, arbitrage, sandwich and front-running extraction, and their measurement or modelling.

topics.name: Fair Ordering & MEV Mitigation
topics.definition: Fair transaction ordering, encrypted mempools, commit-reveal and protocol defences against MEV.

topics.name: Proposer-Builder Separation
topics.definition: PBS, block-building auctions, builders and relays, order-flow auctions, private order flow.

topics.name: Rollups & Sequencers
topics.definition: Rollups, sequencer economics, fraud and validity proofs markets, data-availability pricing for layer 2.

topics.name: Payment Channels & Lightning
topics.definition: Payment channel networks, Lightning Network routing, fees, topology and griefing.

topics.name: Cross-Chain & Bridges
topics.definition: Bridges, atomic swaps, cross-chain arbitrage and interoperability incentives.

topics.name: P2P, Storage & Resource Incentives
topics.definition: Incentives in peer-to-peer propagation, decentralized storage, data availability, node operation and useful work.

topics.name: AMM Design & Theory
topics.definition: Design and theory of automated market makers, constant-function market makers, axioms, optimal curves.

topics.name: Liquidity Provision & LP Returns
topics.definition: Liquidity provider strategies, concentrated liquidity, impermanent loss, loss-versus-rebalancing, LP returns.

topics.name: DEX Trading & Market Quality
topics.definition: Trading on decentralized exchanges, routing, price discovery, DEX market quality and competition with centralized venues.

topics.name: Lending, Liquidations & Flash Loans
topics.definition: DeFi lending protocols, interest-rate models, collateral, liquidations and flash loans.

topics.name: Stablecoins
topics.definition: Stablecoin design, pegs, runs, reserves and their monetary role.

topics.name: Perpetuals & On-Chain Derivatives
topics.definition: Perpetual futures, funding rates, options and other derivatives on or around crypto assets.

topics.name: Oracles & Prediction Markets
topics.definition: Price oracles, oracle manipulation and incentives, on-chain prediction markets.

topics.name: DeFi Risk & Hacks
topics.definition: DeFi systemic risk, composability, contagion, protocol exploits and their financial losses.

topics.name: Crypto Asset Pricing
topics.definition: Return predictability factors, valuation, bubbles and asset-pricing models of crypto assets.

topics.name: Volatility, Spillovers & Hedging
topics.definition: Volatility, connectedness and spillovers with other assets, safe-haven and portfolio diversification properties.

topics.name: Exchange Microstructure
topics.definition: Market microstructure of centralized crypto exchanges: liquidity, spreads, order books, listings, exchange competition, arbitrage across exchanges.

topics.name: Manipulation & Wash Trading
topics.definition: Wash trading, pump-and-dump, insider trading and other market manipulation in crypto markets.

topics.name: Investors & Sentiment
topics.definition: Retail and institutional crypto investors, sentiment, attention, herding, household finance.

topics.name: NFT Markets
topics.definition: NFT pricing, NFT marketplaces and collector behaviour.

topics.name: ICOs, Airdrops & Token Launches
topics.definition: Initial coin offerings, token sales, airdrops, launch mechanisms and memecoin launches.

topics.name: Tokenomics & Monetary Design
topics.definition: Token utility, supply and issuance, burning, token valuation theory, on-chain monetary policy.

topics.name: Adoption & Network Effects
topics.definition: Adoption of cryptocurrencies or blockchains, network effects, competition between chains, firm use of blockchain.

topics.name: Web3 Platforms & Creator Economy
topics.definition: Economics of decentralized platforms, social networks, marketplaces, tokenized communities and creators.

topics.name: CBDC, Payments & Banking
topics.definition: Central bank digital currencies, crypto as money and payments, effects on banks and monetary policy.

topics.name: Regulation & Law
topics.definition: Regulation, securities law, taxation, tokenization of regulated assets, compliance design.

topics.name: Illicit Finance & Scams
topics.definition: Money laundering, sanctions evasion, rug pulls, Ponzi schemes and crypto scams.

topics.name: Energy & Sector Impact
topics.definition: Economic impact of blockchain on energy, environment, electricity markets and other sectors.

topics.name: DAO Governance
topics.definition: DAO participation, proposals, delegation, governance tokens and on-chain governance outcomes.

topics.name: Voting Mechanisms
topics.definition: Design and analysis of on-chain voting rules, quadratic voting, social choice for blockchains.

topics.name: Decentralization & Concentration
topics.definition: Measuring or explaining decentralization, wealth and power concentration, centralization forces in blockchains.

topics.name: Attack Costs & Security Budgets
topics.definition: Cost of attacks, 51% attack economics, security budgets, economic security arguments, double-spend profitability.

topics.name: Bribery & Collusion
topics.definition: Bribing attacks, collusion among validators or participants, censorship markets, dark DAOs.

topics.name: Rational Cryptography
topics.definition: Rational secret sharing, rational multi-party computation, rational proofs and cryptography with strategic adversaries.

topics.name: Fair Exchange & Incentivized Computation
topics.definition: Fair exchange, game-theoretically fair coin toss and leader election, contingent payments, smart contracts that incentivize computation.

topics.name: Stackelberg & Physical Security Games
topics.definition: Stackelberg security games, patrolling, network interdiction, audit games and green security games.

topics.name: Cyber Attack-Defense Games
topics.definition: Game-theoretic models of computer-network attack and defense, moving target defense, deception, FlipIt, intrusion response.

topics.name: Cybercrime & Cyber Insurance
topics.definition: Economics of cybercrime and ransomware, cyber insurance, security investment, vulnerability markets and bug bounties.

topics.name: Privacy Economics
topics.definition: Markets for privacy, privacy-incentive trade-offs, anonymity economics, privacy in mechanisms.

topics.name: Mechanism-Designed Systems
topics.definition: Game-theory- or mechanism-guided design of distributed, parallel, database or cloud systems beyond blockchains.

topics.name: Data & Compute Markets
topics.definition: Blockchain-based or decentralized markets for data, computation and machine learning work.

topics.name: AI Agents & Learning in Crypto
topics.definition: Reinforcement learning or LLM agents acting in crypto markets and protocols, agent payments and agent economies.

topics.name: Formal Verification of Incentives
topics.definition: Formal verification, model checking and strategic logics for incentive or game-theoretic properties of protocols.
